title: Apple researchers introduce Minions distributed GPU cloud system
excerpt: The system aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads.
bodyHtml:
Apple researchers Jianhua Li, Yun Xing, Girisha De Silva, Ryan Flint, Kai Yuan, and Sean Suchter published a paper on October 12, 2026, detailing Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud. The system is designed to aggregate idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to perform machine learning inference.

According to the researchers, the system provides fault tolerance and flexible task execution while allowing teams to utilize existing hardware without additional procurement. The system also enables efficient resource utilization for users.

The team stated that their experience shows idle macOS devices can be transformed into a practical distributed GPU inference platform in environments where centralized GPU resources are constrained. This approach addresses limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints.
